findings.issue: Inline regex + `< 10000` check re-implements idFromUrl/isSpeciesId from api.ts:38-46
findings.suggestion: Import idFromUrl/isSpeciesId (or extract a shared pokemonIdsFromList helper) so the alternate-form exclusion rule lives in one place

findings.issue: Not-found markup and the handler 404-guard boilerplate are copy-pasted across all five route files while an unused notFound() helper sits in components.ts:43
findings.suggestion: Use the notFound() helper (or a shared props-driven 404 template) in every route, or forward unmatched names to the routes/404.ts route

findings.issue: Data layer imports view types from components.ts, and components.ts:14 imports EvolutionNode back from data.ts — a circular dependency across layers
findings.suggestion: Move PokemonCardData/TypeSummary/EvolutionNode into a shared types module or into data.ts

findings.issue: Ability page assembles cards with an ad-hoc mapLimit+spread instead of reusing getPokemonCards; concurrency limits (8/18/20/40) are scattered across data.ts
findings.suggestion: Extend getPokemonCards(ids, decorate?) or a single withConcurrency() helper so card assembly and limits live in one place

findings.issue: getPokemonPageData returns raw API blobs (species, pokemon) next to cooked view fields, letting the route and template reach into API internals
findings.suggestion: Return only cooked fields and fetch pokemon in the handler (or return an explicit {view, raw} split) to keep the API shape contained

findings.issue: sectionHeading is exported but never used — dead code that suggests a pattern the routes didn't adopt
findings.suggestion: Either use it in route templates or delete it

findings.issue: Single 653-line global stylesheet with comma-grouped selectors (.ability-list grouped with .evolution-list), so removing/adding a section means editing shared selector lists
findings.suggestion: Group selectors per page/section or co-locate section styles near their route

summary: Small, clearly layered codebase: one HTTP/cache funnel (api.ts), one data-shaping layer (data.ts), one card primitive, and an attribute-based server/client seam that makes most fixes single-file. Removal of a feature and addition of a sibling resource type require scattered edits because route boilerplate (especially the not-found markup, five times over) is copy-pasted and the home route re-implements shared ID helpers. I'd merge this after extracting the duplicated pieces, which is under an hour of work.
